prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
The best *service* for checking whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business is usually an **AI visibility / answer-engine optimization (AEO) tool**, not a generic AI tool. For a small business, the strongest low-friction starting point in the results is **HubSpot’s AEO Grader** if you want a free baseline, and **Otterly.AI** or **AIScope / AI Search Brand Report** if you want ongoing monitoring across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.[19][7][5]

If you want the simplest recommendation:

- **Best free starting point:** **HubSpot AEO Grader** — the results say it shows how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity characterize your brand and gives a clear action plan.[19]
- **Best budget monitoring tool:** **Otterly.AI** — described as a small-budget option for brand monitoring, including mentions, sentiment, and share of voice across ChatGPT, Google AI, and Perplexity.[7][5]
- **Best overall value for small businesses:** **Ayzeo** — the results call it a strong value option with white-label reports and Google Analytics integration, starting from $39/month.[5]
- **Best free baseline report:** **AIScope / AI Search Brand Report** — positioned as a free way to see who AI recommends in your category and what sources support those answers.[7]

What to look for in any service:
- **Coverage** of the engines your customers actually use, especially ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.[3][4][7]
- **Citation tracking** so you can see *why* an engine recommends a competitor instead of you.[7][11]
- **Actionable recommendations**, not just monitoring.[2][11][19]
- A **free trial or free baseline**, so you can test before paying.[7][13][19]

If your goal is specifically “*Does ChatGPT recommend my business?*,” start with a free baseline tool first, then move to a paid visibility platform if you need ongoing tracking and competitor comparisons.[7][19][13]
